integrity: Symbolic proof and reproducible direct finite checks; not independently validated. The announced general classification in Hou (2011) may overlap, and no historical priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite abelian core quandles only; does not address arbitrary Alexander parameter or nonabelian groups. General Alexander automorphism classification by Hou (2011) is a priority risk; full text unavailable for direct detailed comparison.
title: Affine-rigidity classification and automorphism counts for finite abelian core quandles
